result:
Small order-utility module for a shop backend: computes an order total (`calcTotal`), applies percentage discount codes (`applyDiscount`), computes average item price, and formats an order as text.

Bugs:

1. `calcTotal` (test/orders.js:5) — loop uses `i <= items.length`, reading one past the end; `items[i].price` throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined` on every call, breaking `averageItemPrice` and `formatOrder` too. Should be `i < items.length`.
2. `averageItemPrice` (test/orders.js:20) — divides by `items.length` with no empty check, returning `NaN` for `[]` (even once bug 1 is fixed, since 0/0).

Minor: `applyDiscount` treats a 0% code as no-discount only via the `undefined` check — fine as written, no falsy-value bug currently.
